title: The Wild Robot
author: Peter Brown
description: A robot on a wild island discovers how much there is to learn from the creatures around her.

title: Beetle Boy
author: M. G. Leonard
description: A missing dad, remarkable beetles and a mystery that rewards a very curious mind.

title: The Ickabog
author: J. K. Rowling
description: An imaginary kingdom, a mysterious monster and children brave enough to question the story.

title: The World’s Worst Children
author: David Walliams
description: A collection of outrageous cautionary tales, full of ridiculous behaviour and comic consequences.

title: The Eyes and the Impossible
author: Dave Eggers
description: See a park through the eyes of a fast-running dog with a big heart and an unlikely circle of friends.

title: The One and Only Ivan
author: Katherine Applegate
description: An artistic gorilla tells a moving story about friendship and imagining a better future.
